integrity: Analytical induction establishes the all-configuration result. Exhaustive finite cube checks are supporting diagnostics, not proof of the unbounded-count theorem. No independent scientific validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite purely atomic spaces with strictly positive means and deterministic stopping-set maps; no infinite-atomic, diffuse, randomized, or two-location classification. Classical finite decision-tree normal-form coverage remains a residual originality risk.
title: Fixed-prefix rigidity of one-location stopping sets on finite atomic Poisson spaces
